dataset.generator: code/prepare_dummy_dataset.py; deterministic scenario v5; district-specific dose quotas
dataset.coverage_design: Distinct rounded D3 coverage and numeric dropout per district in the default presentation dataset; deliberately synthetic, not an empirical property

geography.warning: Synthetic immunization data; not actual coverage in these regions

dataset.allocation: Even allocation across district/birth-year groups; remainder distributed to first groups; deterministic offsets of at most 3 children per group with zero net change
dataset.eligibility_rule: Invented dose3_due flag for teaching; not a clinical schedule
dataset.dates: Invented chronological dates; not a recommended vaccination schedule
dataset.quality: IDs unique; flags and events consistent; dates ordered; unknown status absent by design

mapreduce.runtime: Resource-model scheduling of two Python mapper subprocesses, local sort and Python reducer

yarn.resource_units: logical CPU and MiB for the teaching scheduler
